note: The Balcony's fabric (DR-109), built by dev from BALCONY.metadata.json v5 with the parts kit, so its seeds can be rendered from it (graybox-view.mjs). The game: 'an octagonal room, half carved into and half built out from the cliff wall. Through the shattered windows which ring the outer wall you can see ocean to the horizon. A weathered metal plaque ... rests below the windows. A steep stairway, roughly cut into the face of the cliff, leads upward.'

The octagon: apothem 3.94 m to each face, 4 m high, roofed; windows on the SE, S and SW faces from the 1.3 m sill up 2.1 m, 2.8 m wide (metadata wallOpenings); the stair bay in the north face, 1.4 by 3 m.

The cliff face runs east and west through the octagon's middle, so the north half is in the rock and the outer half stands out over the sea; the sea is 10 m below the floor, as on day one (the Crag is 8 m down and its water 2 m below that).
The stair passage runs on into the rock past the metadata's 1 m bay, rising, so the view up it reads as a stair; what it reaches is the Winding Stair's to draw.

The cliff rock under the floor (seed 11) was at y -5.2, where its highest lump stood 0.41 m above the floor and showed as a ridge on it at bearing 112 once floors stopped being drawn as fans (DR-113, 2026-09-18); it is 0.46 m lower, its top 5 cm under the flags, and is otherwise the same rock.
